hero.eyebrow: POM'S KABAHA DUMARKA EE CAALAMIGA AH
hero.title: Xarrago Tallaabo Kasta
hero.subtitle: Baro kabaha dumarka ee casriga ah, naqshadaha gaarka ah ee gacanta lagu farsameeyo, iyo adeegyada jumlada ee caalamiga ah.

customDesign.title: U Rog Fikirkaaga Kabo Dhab Ah
customDesign.description: Ma haysaa naqshad kabo oo aad jeceshahay? Soo geli sawirradaada, dooro nooca maqaarka iyo midabka, oo si toos ah ula shaqee farsamayaqaannadayada.
customDesign.step1Desc: Soo dir sawirro cad oo muujinaya kabaha aad rabto ama sawir-gacmeedkaaga.
customDesign.step2Desc: POM'S wuxuu xaqiijinayaa tayada iyo sida ugu habboon ee loo samayn karo.
customDesign.step3Desc: Waxaan kuu soo bandhigeynaa noocyada maqaarka ee bannaan iyo qiimaha mid kasta.
customDesign.step4Desc: Xaqiiji dalabkaaga waxaana bilaabanaysa samaynta gacanta ee heerka sare ah.

wholesale.title: Jumlo Caalamiya & Dhoofin
wholesale.description: Waxaan dukaamada iyo ganacsatada caalamka siinaa kabo tayo sare leh oo kartoonno ku xiran, tirooyin dabacsan, iyo xamuul xaqiiqo ah.

authenticity.title: Xaqiijinta Asalka Kabaha
authenticity.description: Kabo kasta oo asal ah oo POM'S leedahay waxay wadataa lambar aqoonsi oo gaar ah. Halkan ku xaqiiji kabahaaga si toos ah.

collectionPage.title: Ururinta Kabaha POM'S
collectionPage.description: Sahami naqshadaha xilliga iyo kuwa gaarka ah. Ururin kasta waxaa loo sameeyay raaxo, adkeysi iyo suuqyada raaxada ee caalamiga ah.
